_meta.source: Statistics South Africa — Census 2022; Mid-Year Population Estimates
_meta.notes: Total population is the Stats SA Mid-Year Population Estimate (P0302, cohort-component, 30 June) — 63,522,380 for 2026 (published 2026-07-30); 2025 = 62,762,400 (2026 value minus the stated increase of 759,980). The 2015–2024 series points are DERIVED approximations: Stats SA's 2026 release gives annual growth rates (Appendix 4, 2 decimals) but not the revised totals, so earlier years were back-cast from the exact 2025 value using those rates (error ≲ 0.03M); replace with Stats SA's published 2002–2026 Excel series when available. The previously stored series (e.g. 64.0M for 2024) did not match any Stats SA mid-year estimate. UN/World Bank figures (~65.5M for 2026) use different methods and were not used. Urban population share and median age are Census 2022 measures and are unchanged: the mid-year estimates do not publish an urban share, and no newer comparable official figure was found. Next MYPE expected 2027-07-31. Do NOT run the World Bank updater script for this dataset (it overwrites verified values with annual modelled figures); update manually from the official Stats SA/SARB/DBE release — see antigravity-instructions.md.

statistics.title: Total Population
statistics.description: South Africa's estimated mid-year (30 June) population for 2026 is 63,522,380 according to Stats SA's Mid-Year Population Estimates, an increase of 759,980 on 2025. Annual growth is about 1.2%. Stats SA notes each release revises the whole 2002–2026 series, so figures should not be compared with earlier publications. The 2022 Census counted 62.0 million; mid-year estimates and Census counts are different measures.

statistics.title: Urban Population Share
statistics.description: Percentage of the population living in urban areas, as recorded in Census 2022. Gauteng alone accounts for over a quarter of South Africa's population. The Northern Cape remains the least densely populated province.

statistics.title: Median Age
statistics.description: The median age of the South African population as measured in Census 2022. At 28 years, South Africa has a relatively young population, with significant implications for labour markets, education, and social services.
